marta: Quick sync: runtime lane flapping (FP8/INT8/4bit) is causing customer blips. Need a minimal contract: metrics, API surface, hysteresis defaults.
chris: Two pieces: trigger signals (quality) and rules for when runtime may switch lanes. Per-request switching ok but we need stickiness to avoid oscillation.
kai: Agree per-request + sticky window (~30s). No per-layer switching for now.
marta: Proposal: a scalar `degradation_index` emitted by runtime so routing/rollouts can act.
oliver: Minimal telemetry keys: "perplexity_delta","repeat_token_ratio","embedding_l2_shift","latency_p95","cost_per_k","active_lane","fallbacks_window". Include sampled escrow prompt ids.
sasha: Add "model_seq_len" for normalization and "escrow_prompt_ids" so QA can repro.
chris: Formula (default): degradation_index = 0.5*perplexity_delta_norm + 0.35*repeat_token_ratio_norm + 0.15*embedding_l2_shift_norm. Normalization is endpoint-specific.
kai: For private deployments baseline refs should be a customer-owned hash, not copied.
marta: QuantProfile contract (minimal fields): allowed_lanes, baseline_ref, degrade_threshold (0..1), hysteresis_seconds, quality_mode (best-effort|strict), daily_quality_token_budget, telemetry_keys, escrow_prompts. Example: allowed_lanes:["fp8","int8","int4"], degrade_threshold:0.18, hysteresis_seconds:30, quality_mode:"best-effort", daily_quality_token_budget:250000.
chris: Add `prevent_downgrade_when_hot` rule for streaming responses; only evaluate lane changes between requests or chunk boundaries.
oliver: Runtime API changes: response headers `x-active-lane`, `x-degradation-index`, `x-baseline-id`. Admin endpoints: `/admin/quant/{endpoint}` (aggregates + recent samples) and `/admin/quant/override` (audit-log pinned lane).
sasha: Client hint header `x-request-quality-preference` with values `high|balanced|low` (rate-limited, plan-gated).
kai: Rollout playbook: 1) offline eval against escrow prompts; 2) canary 0.1% traffic with full telemetry; 3) hold and evaluate; 4) auto-rollback if degradation_index > threshold for Y consecutive minutes; 5) ramp with daily budget checks.
marta: Action items: I'll write RFC follow-up with QuantProfile JSON schema and playbook. @chris offline eval harness, @kai add telemetry fields, @oliver implement headers + admin endpoints, @sasha define escrow retention. ack?
chris: ack
kai: ack
oliver: ack
sasha: ack (suggest 14 day default retention)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: quant-canary-collector#811 started for eng-ml/quant-cascade.
marta: Thanks, I'll circulate draft shortly.
